summary: This note covers the 2000 biographical film Pollock and its acting recognition. Marcia Gay Harden won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for playing Lee Krasner, Jackson Pollock's wife. Ed Harris received a Best Actor nomination for playing Pollock, a project he had long pursued after reading Pollock's biography.
one_line: Pollock (film) is a biographical film about painter Jackson Pollock, whose lead actors earned Oscar recognition for their roles.
key_facts: Marcia Gay Harden won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for portraying Lee Krasner, Pollock's wife.
Ed Harris received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor for his portrayal of Pollock.
The film was a long-term personal project for Ed Harris.
The project was based on Ed Harris's previous reading of Pollock's biography.
Ed Harris's father had noticed that Ed Harris resembled Pollock.
